---
title: smalldocs 0.1.4
subtitle: Diffs in red and green, and whole code blocks
date: 2026-10-11
author: Rahul Dave
categories: [release]
image: ../images/mark.svg
---

A `diff` block now shows each removed line in red and each added line in green, as on GitHub. A hunk
header, the line that starts with `@@`, is grey. The text of the block stays as written. See
[Code](../guide/markdown.qmd#code).

The last line of a code block is now read as the other lines are:

- A block of a shell session, such as `console` or `psql`, no longer loses its last line of output.
- A comment on the last line of a `bash` block is now coloured as a comment.
